nodes.code:
# ── Combine the portfolios and save the report (Word + Markdown) ──
import json
import datetime
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt

REPORT_DIR = "Investments/Reports/"
MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"]
CLASSES = ["Australian equities", "International equities", "Property", "Fixed interest", "Cash", "Alternatives", "Other"]

COMMENT_PROMPT = (
    "These are the figures from several investment portfolios an accounting practice looks after, plus the combined "
    "totals. Write a short review for the accountant: overview is 3 to 5 plain sentences on how the investments look "
    "overall (total value, movement, income, allocation, which portfolios stand out). watch is up to 6 points that "
    "need attention (losses, a heavy concentration, a large cash balance, missing figures, valuation dates that "
    "differ). actions is up to 8 follow-ups taken from the portfolios' own actions, each starting with the portfolio's "
    "name. Use only these figures; don't give financial advice or predict markets. Money as $1,234 (no cents)."
)
COMMENT_SHAPE = '{"overview": str, "watch": [str], "actions": [str]}'


def _d(iso):
    try:
        d = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(iso)[:10])
    except ValueError:
        return ""
    return "%02d-%s-%02d" % (d.day, MONTHS[d.month - 1], d.year % 100)


def _money(v):
    if v is None:
        return "-"
    return ("-" if v < 0 else "") + "$" + "{:,.2f}".format(abs(v))


def _pct(v):
    return "-" if v is None else "{:.2f}%".format(v)


def _sum(rows, key):
    vals = [r[key] for r in rows if r.get(key) is not None]
    return round(sum(vals), 2) if vals else None


def _ret(p):
    if p.get("period_return_pct") is not None:
        return p["period_return_pct"]
    o, c = p.get("opening_value"), p.get("closing_value")
    if o and c is not None:
        return round((c - o - (p.get("net_contributions") or 0)) / o * 100, 2)
    return None


portfolios = [p for p in (params.get("portfolios") or []) if isinstance(p, dict)]
skipped = [s for s in (params.get("skipped") or []) if isinstance(s, dict)]
folder = str(params.get("folder_name") or "the SharePoint folder")
problem = str(params.get("problem") or "")
today = datetime.date.today()
stamp = "%02d-%s-%02d" % (today.day, MONTHS[today.month - 1], today.year % 100)

report_file = ""
word_file = ""
total_value = 0.0

if not portfolios:
    summary = problem or "No investment summaries were read, so no report was written."
else:
    portfolios.sort(key=lambda p: -(p.get("closing_value") or 0))
    total_value = round(sum(p["closing_value"] for p in portfolios), 2)
    with_open = [p for p in portfolios if p.get("opening_value") is not None]
    totals = {
        "closing_value": total_value,
        "opening_value": _sum(with_open, "opening_value"),
        "closing_value_with_opening": _sum(with_open, "closing_value"),
        "net_contributions": _sum(portfolios, "net_contributions"),
        "income": _sum(portfolios, "income"),
        "franking_credits": _sum(portfolios, "franking_credits"),
        "fees": _sum(portfolios, "fees"),
        "realised_gain": _sum(portfolios, "realised_gain"),
        "unrealised_gain": _sum(portfolios, "unrealised_gain"),
    }
    alloc = {}
    for p in portfolios:
        for c, v in (p.get("allocation") or {}).items():
            alloc[c] = round(alloc.get(c, 0.0) + v, 2)
    alloc_total = sum(alloc.values())
    alloc_rows = [(c, alloc[c], alloc[c] / alloc_total * 100 if alloc_total else 0.0) for c in CLASSES if alloc.get(c)]
    dates = sorted({p["as_at"] for p in portfolios if p.get("as_at")})
    as_at = _d(dates[-1]) if len(dates) == 1 else (_d(dates[0]) + " to " + _d(dates[-1]) if dates else "not stated")
    movement = None
    if totals["opening_value"] and totals["closing_value_with_opening"] is not None:
        movement = round(totals["closing_value_with_opening"] - totals["opening_value"], 2)

    brief = {
        "totals": totals, "movement_of_portfolios_with_opening": movement, "allocation": alloc,
        "valuation_dates": dates,
        "portfolios": [{k: p.get(k) for k in ("entity", "entity_type", "provider", "as_at", "opening_value",
                        "closing_value", "net_contributions", "income", "fees", "realised_gain", "unrealised_gain",
                        "allocation", "top_holdings", "actions", "notes")} | {"return_pct": _ret(p)} for p in portfolios],
    }
    try:
        c = api.ai.extract(prompt=COMMENT_PROMPT, input=json.dumps(brief)[:28000], schema_hint=COMMENT_SHAPE)
    except Exception as exc:
        c = {"overview": "The AI review couldn't be written this run (" + str(exc)[:150] + "); the figures below are complete.",
             "watch": [], "actions": []}
    c = c if isinstance(c, dict) else {}
    overview = str(c.get("overview") or "").strip()
    watch = [str(x) for x in (c.get("watch") or []) if str(x).strip()][:6]
    actions = [str(x) for x in (c.get("actions") or []) if str(x).strip()][:8]

    title = "Combined Investment Report"
    head_rows = [
        ("Portfolios", str(len(portfolios))),
        ("Combined value", _money(total_value)),
        ("Valuation date", as_at),
        ("Opening value (" + str(len(with_open)) + " with one)", _money(totals["opening_value"])),
        ("Net contributions", _money(totals["net_contributions"])),
        ("Income", _money(totals["income"])),
        ("Franking credits", _money(totals["franking_credits"])),
        ("Fees", _money(totals["fees"])),
        ("Realised gains", _money(totals["realised_gain"])),
        ("Unrealised gains", _money(totals["unrealised_gain"])),
    ]
    pf_head = ["Portfolio", "Type", "Provider", "As at", "Value", "Share", "Return", "Income"]
    pf_rows = [[p["entity"], p.get("entity_type") or "", p.get("provider") or "", _d(p.get("as_at")) or "-",
                _money(p["closing_value"]), _pct(p["closing_value"] / total_value * 100 if total_value else None),
                _pct(_ret(p)), _money(p.get("income"))] for p in portfolios]
    al_head = ["Asset class", "Value", "Weight"]
    al_rows = [[c, _money(v), _pct(w)] for c, v, w in alloc_rows]
    src_rows = [[p["file"], p["entity"]] for p in portfolios]

    # Markdown
    def md_table(head, rows):
        esc = lambda s: str(s).replace("|", "/")
        return "\n".join(["| " + " | ".join(head) + " |", "|" + "---|" * len(head)] +
                         ["| " + " | ".join(esc(x) for x in r) + " |" for r in rows])

    md = ["# " + title, "", "Prepared " + stamp + " from " + str(len(portfolios)) + " investment summaries in " + folder + ".", ""]
    if overview:
        md += ["## Overview", "", overview, ""]
    md += ["## Totals", "", md_table(["Item", "Amount"], [list(r) for r in head_rows]), ""]
    md += ["## Portfolios", "", md_table(pf_head, pf_rows), ""]
    if al_rows:
        md += ["## Combined asset allocation", "", md_table(al_head, al_rows), ""]
    if watch:
        md += ["## Points to watch", ""] + ["- " + w for w in watch] + [""]
    if actions:
        md += ["## Actions", ""] + ["- " + a for a in actions] + [""]
    md += ["## Source files", "", md_table(["File", "Portfolio"], src_rows), ""]
    if skipped:
        md += ["## Not included", ""] + ["- " + str(s.get("file")) + ": " + str(s.get("reason")) for s in skipped] + [""]
    md += ["_Figures are taken from each summary as written; AI wrote the overview, points to watch and actions. "
           "Check against the source files before relying on them. Not financial advice._"]
    report_file = REPORT_DIR + title + " " + stamp + ".md"
    api.files.put(file=report_file, content="\n".join(md) + "\n")

    # Word
    doc = Document()
    doc.styles["Normal"].font.size = Pt(10)
    doc.add_heading(title, level=0)
    doc.add_paragraph("Prepared " + stamp + " from " + str(len(portfolios)) + " investment summaries in " + folder + ".")

    def word_table(head, rows):
        t = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(head))
        t.style = "Table Grid"
        for i, h in enumerate(head):
            t.rows[0].cells[i].text = h
            for run in t.rows[0].cells[i].paragraphs[0].runs:
                run.bold = True
        for r in rows:
            cells = t.add_row().cells
            for i, v in enumerate(r):
                cells[i].text = str(v)

    if overview:
        doc.add_heading("Overview", level=1)
        doc.add_paragraph(overview)
    doc.add_heading("Totals", level=1)
    word_table(["Item", "Amount"], [list(r) for r in head_rows])
    doc.add_heading("Portfolios", level=1)
    word_table(pf_head, pf_rows)
    if al_rows:
        doc.add_heading("Combined asset allocation", level=1)
        word_table(al_head, al_rows)
    if watch:
        doc.add_heading("Points to watch", level=1)
        for w in watch:
            doc.add_paragraph(w, style="List Bullet")
    if actions:
        doc.add_heading("Actions", level=1)
        for a in actions:
            doc.add_paragraph(a, style="List Bullet")
    doc.add_heading("Source files", level=1)
    word_table(["File", "Portfolio"], src_rows)
    if skipped:
        doc.add_heading("Not included", level=1)
        for s in skipped:
            doc.add_paragraph(str(s.get("file")) + ": " + str(s.get("reason")), style="List Bullet")
    doc.add_paragraph("Figures are taken from each summary as written; AI wrote the overview, points to watch and "
                      "actions. Check against the source files before relying on them. Not financial advice.").runs[0].italic = True
    path = api.files.scratch_path("report.docx")
    doc.save(path)
    word_file = REPORT_DIR + title + " " + stamp + ".docx"
    api.files.put(file=word_file, scratch_file=path)

    summary = ("Combined " + str(len(portfolios)) + " portfolios worth " + _money(total_value) + " (" + as_at + "). Saved "
               + word_file + " and " + report_file + "." + (" Skipped " + str(len(skipped)) + " file(s)." if skipped else ""))
